description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three models, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, across two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names listed below each pair of bars. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranges from 0 to 70 in increments of 10, with a linear scale. Each model is associated with a pair of bars, with the left bar in blue representing MMAU and the right bar in purple representing MMAR. The MMAU bars have approximate values of 48, 60, and 64 for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the MMAR bars have approximate values of 30, 36, and 56 for the same models. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU and MMAR bars appearing side by side for each model. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, but the models are listed in a consistent order across both categories.
